request.style: English, traditional spiritual, deep male lead with gospel choir answering, hand claps, foot stomps, Hammond organ, bass, slow and powerful, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Down in the land of Egypt where the bricks were made with tears
The people cried for freedom for four hundred years
Then Moses said, get ready now, put your sandals on your feet
Take a lamb for every household and the bread without the yeast

[Chorus]
When I see the blood, I will pass over you
No plague will come upon you
When I see the blood, I will pass over you
I will pass over you

[Verse]
Paint the doorposts, paint the lintel, stay inside until the dawn
Eat it standing, eat it hurried, with your staff and your cloak on
At midnight came the crying all across the land
But the houses with the blood were held in the LORD's own hand

[Chorus]
When I see the blood, I will pass over you
No plague will come upon you
When I see the blood, I will pass over you
I will pass over you

[Bridge]
This day shall be a day of remembrance for you
And you shall keep it as a festival to the LORD
Throughout your generations

[Outro]
When I see the blood
I will pass over you
